predeclared_resolution_method.name: FROZEN_CASHAHUACRA_TO_MML_R4_RIMAC_D8_FIRST_INTERSECTION_WITH_CORRALES_R5
predeclared_resolution_method.step_1: Build a DEM domain containing the frozen Cashahuacra outlet, MML R5 Corrales and MML R4 Rímac coordinates with a fixed 0.05 degree margin.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_2: Map the frozen Cashahuacra outlet spatial coordinate to the 30 m grid and trace D8 downstream. Require the trace to progress toward and pass within two DEM-cell diagonals of MML R4; truncate at the nearest accepted R4 cell. This is the event-independent Rímac path candidate.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_3: Enumerate grid ambiguity for MML R5 and trace D8 downstream from every admissible R5 cell.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_4: Select the first intersection of each R5 trace with the accepted Cashahuacra-to-R4 path.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_5: Require all admissible R5 cells to converge to exactly one first-intersection cell; otherwise remain PENDING_REVIEW.
predeclared_resolution_method.step_6: Only after convergence may the cell be proposed as the Corrales outlet for the Rayos de Sol target; geometry freezing remains a separate step.
